rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an original model that later things are based on or copied from.

example.english: This ancient city is the archetype for many later castles.
example.traditional: 呢座古城係之後好多城堡嘅原型。
example.jyutping: ne1 zo6 gu2 sing4 hai6 zi1 hau6 hou2 do1 sing4 bou2 ge3 jyun4 jing4

rows.note: Use this for an ideal or quintessential example of a type, rather than its original model.

example.english: He is a real archetype of a filial son.
example.traditional: 佢真係孝順仔嘅典型例子。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zan1 hai6 haau3 seon6 zai2 ge3 din2 jing4 lai6 zi2
